item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02120","case1_error":"Omits the 20% primer discount and charges full price for all primer.","case2_error":"Correctly finds the discounted unit price but uses $250 as both subtotals, duplicating the full-price half's cost.","reason":"One omits the discount entirely; the other recognizes it but substitutes the full-price subtotal for the discounted subtotal.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02121","case1_error":"Uses 3 grams per smaller antacid instead of the stated 1 gram.","case2_error":"Defines total spending as skates plus remaining money, rather than initial money minus remaining money.","reason":"The first substitutes an incorrect given weight; the second constructs an incorrect relation between spending and remaining money.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02122","case1_error":"Adds costs for 14 individual balloons and two packs, purchasing 34 balloons instead of allocating the required 14.","case2_error":"Uses $1 per bead instead of $1 per ten beads, writing an incorrect cost conversion.","reason":"The first double-counts purchases through incompatible allocations; the second confuses a package price with a per-item price.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02123","case1_error":"Invents a divisor, divides inventory by price to count sales, and charges pair pricing for the entire inventory again.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported $260 after correct tax and total-cost formulas; those formulas yield $230.","reason":"The first explicitly constructs erroneous relations and overlapping sales; the second supplies an incorrect final number without showing its evaluation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02124","case1_error":"Mislabels 143 cm as final length and subtracts both cuts; the question also ambiguously describes which boards receive the final cut.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates the correctly written product 30000 × 4 as 12000 instead of 120000.","reason":"The first question inconsistently describes relative board lengths and which boards are cut, making its requested length materially ambiguous. The second clearly miscalculates multiplication.","judgment":"uncertain"}]}
